sources.title: BARBAROSSA CHIMAERA - Ikebe
sources.excerpt: Model: Modern Over Drive. Control: Level / Tone / Drive. Power: DC9V center-negative. Wiring: Point to Point Circuit Board. Case: Aluminum Cutting. Color: Bordeaux Red. Surface finish: Matte Treatment. Other: Cryogenic Processing.

sources.title: Barbarossa Chimaera review
sources.excerpt: Exact-model review identifies controls as Volume, Tone and Gain, notes the 2008 launch, machined aluminum enclosure and hand-wired construction, and describes substantial Volume boost, wide Gain range and practical cleanup from guitar-volume changes.
